2.t: and when the stars fall away

3.t: and when the seas burst forth

4.t: and when the graves spill out

5.t: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind

6.t: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous
6.tr: Yaaa-ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi-Rabbikal kareem

7.t: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design

8.t: moulding you in whatever form He willed
8.tr: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak

9.t: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment

10.t: while you are certainly observed by vigilant

13.t: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss

14.t: and the wicked will be in Hell

15.t: burning in it on Judgment Day

16.t: and they will have no escape from it

17.t: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is

18.t: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is
18.tr: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

19.t: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺
19.tr: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah
